adjudication.reason: Jewel of the Seas is a Radiance-class ship built by Meyer Werft in Papenburg, while Royal Caribbean International is only its owner and operator, which no reasonable person would call the ship's manufacturer, so the model's Miami answer comes from a wrong bridge.
